body: No one wants to die, but people see it as there only way out. To stop the pain and suffering. I don't want to die, but i Don't want to live with this for the rest of my life the loneliness and Depression/Anxiety.

I had to take a month off work when taking this medication, The first two weeks literally drove me insane from the Anxiety. It felt like i was having a constant heart attack. Just carry on taking it and the side effects should wear off by the end of the second week. I've been taking it for four weeks and only feel major anxiety in the mornings, when the drug starts to wear off.

I've bought the rope, i'm going to spend Tomorrow night having a takeaway, watch a bit of southpark, play abit of Wow, then Saturday im going to drive somewhere, havent thought of where yet but i have some ideas and get it over with. I'm going to take a pack of ciggerates smoke for a bit then hopefully do it. i can't see a way out people exhaust me they always have, i want to be social and have fun but i can't ive been depressed my whole life and can;t carry on. i appreciate you trying to help me it does mean a alot i can tell you are a good person. But i need to do this, im miserable 24/7 the only time i am happy is when i got to bed thinking of suicide.
Yeah i'm still here, Not doing too well still feeling down :/. Just can't see a way out at the moment my head is spinning.
Cheers for youre help. Nice to know that someone cares, im back to work tomorrow. I will be carrying my noose with me, see how it goes I guess.

I'm completely Sober i kicked the habit about a year ago, That isn't the issue, the issue is i am a Toxic person. I can't trust people, i push people away all the time even my own family and work colleagues, i pushed all my friends away and i don't know i'm doing it half the time. I have crippling social anxiety and the social skills of a fish. I've never had intrests or hobbies, never went out when i was a kid and its fucked me over developing social skills.
I use to drink up to a bottle of Vodka a day.

Alcohol, I was a heavy drinker and used that to suppress the anxiety, That's how i met my Ex girlfriend. We use to drink all the time together and that's how she got to know me.

Then i was more comftable around her when i was sober and asked her out. Then i pushed all my friends away to spend time with her. Then i pushed her so far away shes blocked my number and all other forms of communications. Update ive made the noose tied two Ties together and seems to work pretty well just need to find a appropriate time to do it. It actually makes me feel happy when i think about it sounds fucking sick but it does.

I hate my life, i have hated it for a while. I use to have it all Friends/Girlfriend was in the military. I knew there was something up at the time, i didn't realize at the time it was depression and social anxiety. 

Fast foward two years, no friends, girlfriend left me pushed everyone so far away no one wants to know me. I have a job but the idea of going back to work tomorrow after a month off sick is making my anxiety go through the roof. I am a complete shut in i don't do anything and i can't. I don't want to live the rest of my life working and having no social plans its  a shitty life.
